visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a grey suit jacket and black pants stands on a red-carpeted stage, holding a microphone and addressing an audience. Behind her, a large LED screen displays a wedding photo of a couple in front of a classical building. To her left is a music stand, and to her right is an electronic keyboard on a stand. In the foreground, banquet chairs with red covers and gold ribbons are visible. (2) The scene transitions through various shots of the woman singing. She moves rhythmically to the music, gesturing with her free hand and occasionally touching her chest. The LED background shifts through different wedding photos of the same couple in various romantic settings like gardens and staircases. (3) The camera focuses closer on the woman's face as she delivers an emotional vocal performance, closing her eyes and leaning into the microphone. Yellow variety-style text overlays appear intermittently at the bottom center of the frame, commenting on her actions and performance style. (4) The woman continues her performance across the stage, maintaining a confident posture while interacting with the invisible audience. Guests are partially visible seated at tables in the periphery, illuminated by the bright, warm indoor stage lighting that highlights the red curtains and carpet of the performance area.
